PROJECTS.TECHNOLOGIES: Ruby on Rails, Node, React, Postgres and AWS

PROJECTS.PROJECT: Agent platform with a built-in evaluation layer
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Platform for corporate agents built on a single thesis: measurement is what makes cost optimization safe, because every saving, a smaller model, a cache, less context, is a bet that quality held. The agent loop runs end to end with streaming, tool calls and full tracing, durable runs on Temporal, and a deterministic provider that keeps it testable in CI without network.
PROJECTS.TECHNOLOGIES: Ruby on Rails, React, Temporal and AI APIs

PROJECTS.PROJECT: Natural-language analytics over the education data warehouse
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Reads the transactional database, materializes flat tables in Parquet and answers questions in plain Portuguese about them, using text-to-SQL rather than RAG, because the questions are analytical and embeddings over rows miss counts and filters. Business rules live in SQL, not in the model, so the answer is the same every day and can be justified to a school, and it's now becoming a multi-tenant product.
PROJECTS.TECHNOLOGIES: Python, DuckDB, Parquet, FastAPI and AI APIs

PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Validates the school census file against the official INEP layout before submission, naming the exact field, the reason and the fix. The engine is deterministic, with rules extracted from the official spreadsheet into versioned caches, and AI only translates irregular rules into specs, once, without ever evaluating the file itself, which keeps every run reproducible and auditable.

EARLIER_WORK.NOTE: Infrastructure and applications provisioned through Terraform from a console instead of a shell, with encrypted credentials and an audit trail.
